integrity: The standalone standard-library check.py reproduces exact-rational vertex-step and edge-norm comparisons. Exact parameter bounds are consequences of proof, not of finite grids.
scientific_limitations: Finite real signals on unweighted stars, homogeneous holding probability fixed across steps, and unweighted edge-sum variation only; no assertion for arbitrary stochastic kernels, time-varying policies, distributional mixing, or weighted stars. Exact norm and optimizer are proved analytically. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: Parity-dependent optimal laziness for finite-horizon star-walk variation
